def get_docx_tables(path):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:

await write_file("./paragraphs.json", para_data)

inst = await run_command("uv pip install fpdf2 2>&1")
print(inst)

import asyncio
await asyncio.sleep(5)
chk = await run_command("python -c \"from fpdf import FPDF; print('fpdf2 OK')\" 2>&1")
print(chk)

lines = [
    "import json",
    "import os",
    "from fpdf import FPDF",
    "from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart",
    "from email.mime.text import MIMEText",
    "from email.mime.application import MIMEApplication",
    "from datetime import datetime",
    "",
    "os.makedirs('output', exist_ok=True)",
    "",
    "with open('paragraphs.json', 'r') as f:",
    "    paragraphs = json.load(f)",
    "",
    "pdf = FPDF()",
    "pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=True, margin=15)",
    "pdf.add_page()",
    "",
    "for style, text in paragraphs:",
    "    safe = text.encode('latin-1', 'replace').decode('latin-1')",
    "    if style == 'Title':",
    "        pdf.set_font('Helvetica', 'B', 18)",
    "        pdf.cell(0, 12, safe, new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT')",
    "        pdf.ln(4)",
    "    elif style == 'Heading1':",
    "        pdf.set_font('Helvetica', 'B', 14)",
    "        pdf.ln(6)",
    "        pdf.cell(0, 10, safe, new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT')",
    "        pdf.ln(2)",
    "    else:",
    "        pdf.set_font('Helvetica', '', 10)",
    "        pdf.multi_cell(0, 6, safe)",
    "        pdf.ln(1)",
    "",
    "pdf.output('output/customer_report.pdf')",
    "pdf_size = os.path.getsize('output/customer_report.pdf')",
    "print('PDF created: ' + str(pdf_size) + ' bytes')",
    "",
    "msg = MIMEMultipart()",
    "msg['From'] = 'noreply@example.com'",
    "msg['To'] = 'bob@example.com'",
    "msg['Subject'] = 'Customer Activity Report'",
    "msg['Date'] = datetime.now().strftime('%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S +0000')",
    "",
    "body = MIMEText('Hi Bob,\\n\\nPlease find attached the Customer Activity Report.\\n\\nBest regards', 'plain')",
    "msg.attach(body)",
    "",
    "with open('output/customer_report.pdf', 'rb') as f:",
    "    att = MIMEApplication(f.read(), _subtype='pdf')",
    "    att.add_header('Content-Disposition', 'attachment', filename='customer_report.pdf')",
    "    msg.attach(att)",
    "",
    "with open('output/customer_report_email.eml', 'w') as f:",
    "    f.write(msg.as_string())",
    "",
    "eml_size = os.path.getsize('output/customer_report_email.eml')",
    "print('EML created: ' + str(eml_size) + ' bytes')",
    "print('DONE')",
]
script_text = "\n".join(lines)
await write_file("./gen_pdf_email.py", script_text)
print("Generation script written.")

gen_result = await run_command("python ./gen_pdf_email.py 2>&1")
print(gen_result)

out_files = await list_files("./output")
print(out_files)

eml_head = await read_file("./output/customer_report_email.eml", start_line=1, end_line=15)

eml_file_info = await get_file_info("./output/customer_report_email.eml")

print(f"EML info: {eml_file_info}")
